run_fused_moe_lora: run the fused MoE LoRA kernel to compute expert outputs with optional TMA and GDC acceleration
run_fused_moe_lora_shrink: run the shrink phase of fused MoE LoRA to multiply input hidden states by LoRA A weights
run_fused_moe_lora_expand: run the expand phase of fused MoE LoRA to multiply intermediate cache by LoRA B weights and accumulate into output
refactor_fused_moe_lora_kernel: refactor the Triton JIT kernel _fused_moe_lora_kernel to support grouped GEMM with split-K and TMA descriptors
test_fused_moe_lora: test the fused MoE LoRA custom op registration and its fake implementation for torch.compile compatibility
